name: Shackleton crater rim (lunar south pole)
tiers_note: relative: exact = top 0.5% of Earth land cells, strong = top 2%, moderate = top 5%, variable = top 10%
method: Gaussian similarity per dimension, sigma = 1/4 of Earth 5-95th percentile range; slope and relief in log space; weighted geometric mean across dimensions. Day/night/swing temperature share one vote; dimensions beyond anything on Earth (earth_gaps) are reported but do not vote; the result is multiplied by the cell's land share (land), so open water cannot rank
